about_the_game:
If you want to be a successful wizard, you gotta make a name for yourself. And for that you gotta take part in the Tome Tumble Tournament. It's the biggest event for wizards from around the world to show off their skills. Prepare your thickest and heaviest magical folios that you spent so many years working on and get ready for some outdoor exercise!

Moving those giant books around isn't that simple! Turn them just the right way, and they will spread open, unleashing the magical powers contained within. You'll have to use various techniques and maneuvers to successfully complete the challenges of the Tournament. Just make sure you don't throw any tomes face-down on the ground — you'll be disqualified if you get mud on those precious pages.

A Curious Classic

A familiar block-pushing puzzle gameplay is spiced up with a novel mechanic: the book will spread open whenever it lands on its spine. Discover the movement capabilities of tome-based sports equipment and use them for your advantage!

An Enchanted Experience

Some of the books contain magical powers which are activated at the moment the book spreads open. These spells will affect the world around you, momentarily changing the rules and introducing more fun problems to solve!

A Concealed Conspiracy

Why are these books so ridiculously large? Where does all that paper come from? Who is really running the Tournament? There might be more to it all than meets the eye...
